questions.markdown:
Two loads with impedances $(24 + j32)\ \Omega$ and $(30 + j40)\ \Omega$ are connected in parallel across a single-phase 230 V, 50 Hz supply. Calculate,

a) Current through both loads
b) Total active power
c) Total reactive power
d) Capacitance of the capacitor to be connected across the parallel combination to raise the overall power factor of the circuit to 0.95 lagging.

Two wattmeters are connected to measure the power in a 3-phase circuit, reading 5 kW and 1 kW, with the reading of the second wattmeter obtained after reversing the potential coil of the wattmeter. Calculate,

a) Total active power
b) Total reactive power
c) Power factor

A 3-phase, 3-wire, 415V, RYB supply is connected to a balanced star connected RL load of phase impedance $6 + j8\ \Omega$. Taking $V_{RN}$ as reference, calculate:

a) All line currents
b) Neutral shift voltage
c) Total active power
d) Draw the phasor diagram

Calculate the reluctance of the ring and the current required to produce a flux of 0.3mWb in the air gap. The relative permeability of the ferromagnetic material is 800.
